description: This file defines the RunStats class, which is used for accumulating, summarizing, and managing runtime statistics from TensorFlow session runs within the Android environment. It provides methods for enabling stats collection, adding metadata, and generating summaries of accumulated stats.

classes.name: RunStats
classes.description: A class for collecting and analyzing runtime statistics from TensorFlow session executions on Android.

methods.name: runOptions
methods.description: Returns a byte array containing options to enable full trace level stats.

methods.name: RunStats
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new RunStats object, allocating native resources.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Releases native resources associated with this RunStats instance.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds runtime metadata to the statistics collection.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing the collected runtime statistics.
